title: AI-assisted document drafting chat (ANDS dossier builder)
walkthrough:
You are inside a dossier's module workspace: a section tree on the left, a work panel in the centre, and a status rail on the right showing a progress bar (e.g. "required sections complete") and three gate flags — "Documents", "Fee", "Valid eCTD". In the tree, each section has a status glyph and badges: "req" or "opt", plus a "✦AI" badge on sections that support AI drafting (its tooltip reads "This section supports interactive AI drafting — you review and approve before anything is saved").

Clicking a section opens its panel: an eyebrow line ("Module … · Section …"), the section title, and a guidance box headed "What Health Canada needs here" with a link "Health Canada guidance ↗". Below sits an action bar with tabs "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and "⊘ Mark N/A".

Choosing "✦ Author in-app" on an AI-enabled section reveals a mode toggle: "💬 Draft with AI" (default) versus "✦ Fill the form". In AI mode you see the note "Chat with an AI assistant to draft this document — it will ask for any details it needs instead of leaving blanks. Nothing is saved until you click Use this draft." An empty thread shows "Tell it about the submission to get started — it knows what [section title] needs." You type into a box with the placeholder "e.g. Sponsor is Acme Pharma Inc., contact regulatory@acme.example" and press "Send" (Enter also sends); the button reads "Thinking…" while the reply streams in as chat bubbles.

Once a reply finishes, a button "Use this draft →" appears ("Saving…" while it works). Clicking it saves the latest AI reply. The saved document then appears in the panel with filename, size, a "fingerprint md5" prefix (labelled document control, not validation), a "Download" link, and a chip. Because the draft is unconfirmed, the chip reads "AI draft — review & confirm" and a persistent, on-screen banner sits above the document: "⚠ Not yet filable — review required. This is an AI-assisted draft. It will not count as complete and the submission cannot be exported until you review it against the Health Canada guidance and attest it as your own content:" followed by a button "I have reviewed this AI draft — it is my content" ("Recording…" while it saves; the attestation is recorded to the audit trail). The chip's tooltip states: "Drafted interactively with the AI assistant under your direction, and recorded in the audit trail. Data residency: your dossier text is sent to the configured AI provider for this draft only, isolated per sponsor — it is never shared across clients or used to train models. This is assistance, not a filing: review it against the Health Canada guidance and confirm it as your own content before filing." After you attest, the chip changes to "AI-assisted · confirmed" and the banner clears. The Review/attest action sits with the draft, on the saved-document card itself.

If the AI backend isn't configured, the chat shows "AI drafting isn't set up yet (no GROQ_API_KEY). Switch to the "✦ Fill the form" tab above to author this section instead, or ask an admin to configure it."
